verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://developer.brex.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents for the Brex Developer API. The developer docs themselves are served as markdown (.md) pages, such as the guides, OpenAPI references, and MCP docs, which an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and agent-oriented docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant or usage guidance) is not evidenced.
